source_mode: One new immutable source capsule for every final paired arm. Record all numerical and compile-path differences.
selector: At each discovery QPS,retain every family/action/policy outcome. Require action and runtime correctness and task quality. Require both ITLp99 and TPOTp95 point ratios<=1.05 against NativeStrong and common-policy Native. Select minimum TTFTp95 within each pure/interior family. Break exact ties by SLO-goodput. Freeze each choice before any new held-out latency run. Native is a no-offload competitor,not excluded from serving conclusions.
unmeasured_QPS_policy: Use the QPS1.8-frozen action at QPS1.0. Use the QPS2.8-frozen action at QPS4.5. No new cut selection from test outcomes.
safety: The final paired start-level95percent CI upper bound must be<=1.05 for both ITLp99 and TPOTp95. Check NativeStrong and common-policy Native separately. Absolute TTFT5000/everyITL34/TPOT33 thresholds remain frozen.
uncertain_cell_rule: Retain three starts as the main evidence. Do not repeat until a preferred sign appears. Any five-start extension needs a new explicit pre-run reason and must retain all three original starts.
correctness: Selected static actions and every new runtime composition need full400 state/lifetime stress before final performance.
limitations: Held-out means not used for static latency tuning. Dataset natural generation,quality gates and some baseline pilots already observed parts of these contexts. Finite-cohort drain throughput is not sustainable capacity. Agg batching is not the same geometry as1P1D. The C0 iso-work mechanism confirmation remains separate from C3 best-versus-best serving.
